Standard turnaround is 14 business days from when we have your approved logo and order — so plan ahead and book early to lock in your tournament date. Give it to your tournament organizer, hand it to the winner of the scramble, raffle it off, or keep it for yourself — your call. No coupon code, no fine print. Pickup or shipping? Both options work. You can pick up your finished order at our Milton, WA factory (2025 Freeman Road East), or we can ship to your office or directly to the golf course. Just let our sales team know which you prefer when you submit your quote. Can you ship directly to the golf course? Yes. We can ship to your office, the course pro shop, or directly to the tournament organizer. Just put the address in your quote request. What sizes do you carry? Standard adult sizes XS through 6XL across most styles. Women’s cuts are available in matching styles. Size availability and upcharges (typically $2 for 2XL, $3 for 3XL) confirmed in your quote.

pages.mainText: High-Vis Safety Stripes · Screen-Printed In-House Since 1977 Custom Safety Stripe Apparel Bold high-visibility safety stripes — screen-printed on hi-vis tees, hoodies, and vests, with your logo worked right in. Keep your crew seen and branded, for a fraction of the cost of certified gear. Pick a stripe layout, or our artist designs custom. Get a Safety Quote See Stripe Designs Trusted by Pacific NW crews since 1977 · Screen-printed in our Milton shop · Custom stripe designs in-house High-visibility stripes + your logo, on hi-vis gear Layout menu or custom stripes by our in-house artist Screen-printed in Milton, WA — no middleman Pick Your Safety Stripe Design These are design ideas we can screen-print on your hi-vis gear — mix any stripe style with any logo placement, or have our in-house artist build something custom. Steve adds new layouts all the time. Standard Stripes Construction Zone Diamond Plate Warning White & Orange White & Yellow White & Metallic Silver White & Green Just Stripes (no logo) Left-Chest Logo Front-Center Logo Back-Center Logo Text Between the Lines Built-In Image Don't see your look? Ask Steve for custom stripes → Good to know: These are custom screen-printed design ideas — bold, high-visibility safety stripes we print on your apparel. Screen-printed safety-stripe shirts and hoodies are not ANSI/ISEA 107 certified safety garments. If your job site requires certified hi-vis, we carry it — just ask. See certified hi-vis → Designed in-house Custom stripes, in-house Steve will design custom safety stripes for your crew. Want your logo built into the stripes, a specific color combo, or your company name running across the back? Our in-house graphic artist, Steve, designs custom safety-stripe layouts from scratch — on these hi-vis shirts, hoodies, and vests. You approve a proof before anything is printed. It's the same crew, same Milton shop that's been screen-printing for the Pacific Northwest since 1977 — no outside decorator, no guesswork. Get a Safety Quote Call or Text 253-922-5793 The Hi-Vis Gear We Print On Our top-selling safety blanks — safety green, orange, and yellow tees, hoodies, and a certified vest. Tap any style for live colors and details, then we print your stripes on it. Core Blend Tee · PC55 Ultra Cotton Tee · 2000 Dri-POWER 50/50 Tee · 29M Long Sleeve Tee · PC55LS Heavy Blend Hoodie · 18500 Essential Fleece Hoodie · PC90H ANSI Class 2 Safety Vest · CSV405 DryBlend Hoodie · 12500 Tall Fleece Hoodie · PC90HT Need certified hi-vis? We also carry CornerStone ANSI-rated safety gear → Real Crews. Real Stripes. Real printed hoodies On the job, hi-vis Striped hi-vis hoodie Logo + stripes Seen from a distance Landscaping crew hoodie Back-print stripes + logo Dirt-works crew hoodie Your crew could be next. Get a safety quote → How It Works Plan ahead — standard turnaround is 14 business days from art approval. 1 Pick Gear & a Stripe Design Choose your hi-vis blanks (tees, hoodies, or a vest) and a stripe layout above — or ask for custom. We'll match the safety color to your crew. 2 Send Your Logo Steve works your logo into the stripe design and shows you a proof. Names, department marks, and back prints all welcome. 3 Outfit the Crew Pick up at our Milton factory in about 14 business days — or have us ship to your office or job site. Reorders keep your art on file. Common Questions What are custom safety stripes? They're bold high-visibility stripes we screen-print across the front and back of hi-vis apparel, usually with your company name or logo worked in. They make a crew stand out on the job — and put your brand on the gear at the same time — at a fraction of the cost of buying certified reflective garments for everyone. Do safety stripe shirts meet ANSI requirements? A screen-printed hi-vis tee or hoodie is high-visibility work apparel, not a certified ANSI/ISEA 107 garment. If your job site requires certified hi-vis, we also carry certified options like the CornerStone ANSI 107 Class 2 mesh-back safety vest (CSV405) — tell us the requirement and we'll match it. For crews that just need to be seen and branded, the safety-stripe shirts and hoodies are the value pick. Can I pick a stripe design or get a custom one? Both. Choose from our stripe layouts — Standard, Construction Zone, Diamond Plate, Warning, back-center logo, and more — or our in-house graphic artist Steve will design custom stripes for your crew with your logo, colors, and text. Every design gets a proof before we print. What apparel can you print safety stripes on? Hi-vis tees, long-sleeves, and hoodies in safety green, orange, and yellow, plus safety vests. Our top sellers are the Port & Company, Gildan, and Jerzees hi-vis blanks — shown below — but we can print stripes on most hi-vis styles you like. Is there a minimum order for custom safety stripes? Screen printing prices best at two dozen and up, where most crew orders land. Smaller runs carry a small-batch fee that's quoted up front. Every quote shows the real number before anything goes to production.
